_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit the values below. One server handles every screen and every coop - see README's 'Multiple coops'.
_comment_port: Port the web server listens on.
_comment_adminPasscode: Simple passcode required to open the admin (roster editing) screen, entered on a big on-screen numpad. Change this.
_comment_phoneVisibility: 'always' (default): shown on the status popup. 'hash': placeholder text only. 'off': not shown.
_comment_boardClickToEdit: Per-server default for tap-to-edit on the board. Override per screen with ?input=off or ?input=on in that screen's board.html URL.
_comment_theme: Optional. One of server/themes.js's ids ('dark', 'christmas', 'light'). Seeds data/theme.json on first boot only; admin 'Utseende' tab is the source of truth after that.
_comment_popupIdleTimeoutMs: Optional. Milliseconds of inactivity before a popup auto-closes. Seeds data/settings.json on first boot only; admin 'Inställningar' tab is the source of truth after that.
_comment_onscreenKeyboardAdmin: Optional. Show the on-screen keyboard on the admin page's own text fields. Seeds data/settings.json on first boot only.
